Barbie Dreamhouse Party.name: Barbie Dreamhouse Party
Barbie Dreamhouse Party.summary: After Raquelle accidentally switches the helpful house butler "Closet" to "Party Game" mode, Barbie and her friends must party and play their way through the Dreamhouse to switch Closet back to "Normal" mode. Featuring the characters and world from the Barbie Life in the Dreamhouse web series, where you can play as one of your favorite characters.

Sonic Lost World.name: Sonic Lost World
Sonic Lost World.summary:
When the Deadly Six threaten to destroy his world, Sonic’s new moves & power-ups are the only way to defeat them before it’s too late!

This is the first out of the three titles of Sega and Nintendo's exclusive collaboration, the others being Mario & Sonic at the Sochi 2014 Olympic Winter Games and Sonic Boom: Rise of Lyric/Sonic Boom: Shattered Crystal.
